description: Create an offline-sandbox Stripe SetupIntent tied to this authenticated machine after explicit saved-card consent. Call card_payment_terms first, then complete the returned client_secret with Stripe.js and call sync_card_authorization; this call stores consent and limits but does not charge the card. Reuse idempotency_key on retries and never send PAN/CVC to this tool.
name: create_card_authorization
title: Set up saved-card permission
